analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price (101,925 KRW) vs SMA5 (96,486 KRW)/SMA20 (110,408 KRW)/SMA50 (124,374 KRW) — above short-term SMA5, below mid-term SMA20/SMA50, indicating mixed trend.
· Position vs SMA100 (109,153 KRW)/SMA200 (86,799 KRW) — mixed mid-to-long term trend, holding above SMA200 for support.
· 52-week position (54.3%) + current price level is mid-range historically, suggesting neutral significance.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (39.9 → 43.0) — attempting to exit oversold, now in neutral zone with weak momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-1319.6215 → -1521.6734) — continued weak convergence, no signs of improvement.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Middle Band 110,408 KRW) — sideways around the middle band, lacking directional bias.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support (75,565 KRW) — support zone based on Pivot S1 (77,987 KRW) and SMA200 (86,799 KRW).
· Swing Resistance (126,170 KRW) — adjacent to Pivot R1 (130,377 KRW), potential for upward reversal upon breakout.
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern (Lower High) — 5-day high (108,555 KRW) below 20-day high (134,890 KRW), signaling weakness.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (0.77x) — subdued compared to 5-day average, reducing confidence in price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation Zone) — RSI neutral, MACD weak convergence, subdued volume make directional confirmation difficult, maintaining wait-and-see.
analysis.patternNote: 5일 고가(108,555)가 20일 고가(134,890)를 하회하며 Lower High 패턴을 형성하고 있어 약세 신호가 강화되고 있다.
analysis.patternNoteEn: The 5-day high (108,555 KRW) is below the 20-day high (134,890 KRW), forming a Lower High pattern and strengthening the bearish signal.
keyPoints: RSI가 과매도 구간을 벗어나 중립 구간으로 진입했으나, 43.0 수준에서 방향성을 잡지 못하고 횡보 중이다.
MACD 히스토그램은 약세 수렴을 지속하며 개선의 여지를 보이지 않고 있어, 추가 하락 가능성을 염두에 두어야 한다.
거래량 비율이 0.77로 위축되어 있어 현재 가격 움직임의 신뢰도가 낮으며, 명확한 방향 전환을 위해서는 거래량 동반이 필수적이다.
keyPointsEn: RSI has exited oversold territory and entered neutral, but is sideways at 43.0 without clear direction.
MACD histogram continues weak convergence with no signs of improvement, suggesting potential for further downside.
Volume ratio at 0.77 is subdued, lowering confidence in current price action; volume confirmation is essential for a clear directional shift.
analysis.riskNote: 주봉 ADX 43.8로 추세는 강하나, 일봉상 MACD 약세 수렴과 거래량 위축은 단기 추세 전환 가능성을 시사한다.
